heroHeadline: Iran Peace Deal 'Imminent' — Al-Arabiya Leaks Final Draft; House War Powers Vote Canceled; Taiwan's Lai 'Happy' to Call Trump on $14B Arms Sale
heroSubtitle: On May 22, 2026 (Day 83 of the US-Iran war), Saudi satellite network Al-Arabiya reported a leak of the 'final draft' of a US-Iran peace agreement mediated by Pakistan, claiming a deal announcement could come 'within hours.' The leaked framework includes Hormuz blockade lifting, an immediate ceasefire, and a 30-day nuclear negotiation window — but does not address the core US demand of an enrichment moratorium or HEU surrender. Brent crude eased from ~$107 to ~$104/bbl on deal speculation. Separately, House Republican leadership abruptly canceled an Iran war powers resolution vote the same day as GOP defections threatened its passage — exposing deepening fractures within the Republican caucus over the war's constitutional authorization. Taiwan President Lai Ching-te publicly responded to Trump's May 21 call announcement, saying he would be 'happy' to speak with the US president — a potentially historic presidential call between Washington and Taipei not seen since 1979. Beijing demanded the US handle Taiwan 'with utmost prudence.' Trump signed the 'Restoring Integrity to America's Financial System' EO on May 20 directing banks to factor immigration status in risk assessments. The Gallrein-over-Massie Kentucky primary victory (May 19-20, $32.6M) remains the second term's biggest MAGA scalp. Trump's net approval sits at a second-term low of -20.1 (Silver Bulletin, May 20).
